title: Valheim World Editor mod manifest (worldeditor.json)
description: What a Valheim mod tells the Valheim World Editor about itself. See docs/modding.md.

data.description: By data key, as the mod's code names it.

label.description: How the inspector names the value.

readOnly.description: The inspector shows the value but does not let it be changed.

help.description: What the value is, shown when pointing at it.

hidden.description: Not offered in Place or the Workshop's Build panel.
